name: Call → Payment Link → Email Receipt
description: When an ElevenLabs conversational AI call finishes, create a Stripe payment link and email it to the customer via Gmail.

plan.name: Call to payment link to email
plan.description: Fetch the completed call transcript, create a Stripe payment link, and send it to the customer by email.
plan.prompt: When a call finishes, create a payment link and email it to the customer.

trigger.description: Fires when an ElevenLabs conversational AI call finishes and a transcript is available.

conversation_id.description: ID of the completed ElevenLabs conversation.

steps.title: Fetch the call transcript
steps.rationale: Retrieve the completed conversation so we know the call happened and can reference it.

steps.title: Create a Stripe payment link
steps.rationale: Generate a hosted payment link for the customer to pay.

mappings.note: Placeholder Stripe Price ID — replace with the real price for this workflow.

steps.title: Email the payment link to the customer
steps.rationale: Send the generated payment link so the customer can pay.

mappings.note: Replace with the base64url-encoded email; include the payment link from $steps.step_2.response.url in the body before sending.
